method: Seven ANSYS shell FE basis solves plus linear lumped ventilation heat balance; not CFD
equation: Tair = Tamb + P/(Gshell + rho*cp*Vfresh); Tnode = Tamb + theta_node*(Tair-Tamb)

air_properties.basis: Approximate constant room-temperature dry air at sea-level pressure

heat_input_scope: Analyst-selected heat fully released into perfectly mixed air; no direct component-to-shell contacts
flow_scope: Assumed net fresh-air replacement. These are not fan-4007 ratings, measured flow, or guaranteed bounds.
zero_flow_scope: No net fresh-air exchange, not necessarily stopped fan. Linear extrapolation only; material/air assumptions can break down.
temperature_flag_scope: 50C is an analyst review flag, not a filament safety/failure threshold
ambient_scope: A 10K ambient increase shifts all modeled temperatures by 10K only under fixed-property assumptions

representative_case.interpretation: hypothetical bulk-air/shell result; no component temperatures or resolved flow
